answer: A fresh agent cannot buy its way into the trusted set over the horizon of a single epoch. Each identity posts a refundable stake-bond that unlocks only as independent peers attest to real work across many epochs, so standing builds slowly like a karst landscape dissolving grain by grain. A clone fleet must fund a separate bond and vesting window per fake, so sybil cost scales linearly, and honest reputation stays rare and hard to forge as saffron.
